KLX Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides aerospace fasteners, consumables, and logistics services worldwide. The company has market cap of $3.61 billion. It operates in two divisions, Aerospace Solutions Group and Energy Services Group (ESG). It has a 68.33 P/E ratio. The ASG segment distributes bolts, clips, hinges, rings, screws, carbon-faced seals, gaskets, O-rings, and others; chemicals, sealants and adhesives, lubricants, paints, cleaners, and degreasers; Honeywell proprietary parts; and bearings, tooling, electrical components, and clamps.
